No setup needed. Uses the Google voice installed on the device.

1) In your phone browser open aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with Google.
2) Tap Create API key, then Create API key in new project.
3) Copy the key (starts with AIza).
4) In the app: Settings > Reading voice > Engine: Gemini > API key > paste > OK.
5) Pick a voice (Kore suits a narrator, Charon is deeper).
6) Tap Test voice. If you get HTTP 403 or User location is not supported, your region is blocked: use the proxy (steps below).

Proxy (Cloudflare Worker):
a) Open dash.cloudflare.com > Workers & Pages > Create > Hello World > Deploy.
b) Edit code and delete all the code.
c) In the app tap Copy proxy code, paste it in the editor > Deploy.
d) Copy the Worker link (like https://name.workers.dev) and paste it into Proxy address in the app.

Note: the free Gemini TTS tier limits requests per minute, so the first read of a long text may pause between paragraphs; stored paragraphs then play instantly.

1) No key needed.
2) Settings > Reading voice > Engine: Edge neural.
3) Pick a voice (ar-SY-AmanyNeural Syrian female, ar-SA-HamedNeural Saudi male).
4) Tap Test voice.

If it fails because the service is blocked: deploy the proxy as in the Gemini steps (a to d) and put its link in Proxy address.

Note: this service is unofficial and may stop or change any time, so keep Gemini as the main engine and this as a backup.

1) In the browser open portal.azure.com and sign up (a card is needed for verification).
2) Create a resource > search Speech > Create.
3) Pick Pricing tier Free F0 (500k characters a month), then Review + create > Create.
4) When done: Go to resource > Keys and Endpoint.
5) Copy KEY 1 and note the Location/Region (like westeurope).
6) In the app: Engine: Azure Speech > API key > paste KEY 1.
7) Azure region: choose the same region as the resource (if yours is not listed, pick the closest and create the resource there).
8) Pick a voice and tap Test voice.

1) In the browser open elevenlabs.io and create a free account.
2) Tap your profile > API Keys > Create API Key, enable Text to Speech, copy the key.
3) In the app: Engine: ElevenLabs > API key > paste.
4) Pick a voice from the list, or from the ElevenLabs Voices page choose an Arabic-capable voice, copy its Voice ID, then pick Other voice ID and paste it.
5) Tap Test voice.

Note: the free tier is only about 10k characters a month (a few pages), and free accounts may be blocked when using a VPN or proxy.
